findings.title: Classification accuracy remains unverified
findings.evidence: The report discusses classification accuracy but also indicates that it has not been independently verified.
findings.recommendation: Create a manually labelled evaluation set and report per-category precision, recall, and confusion cases.

findings.title: Ground-truth coverage may be limited
findings.evidence: The report mentions three sessions in its ground-truth discussion. Confirm the overlap count and coverage before generalizing performance.
findings.recommendation: Evaluate additional complete sessions and clearly state the sample size and limitations.

findings.title: Human control is preserved in the inspected implementation
findings.evidence: A Python dictionary explicitly sets automatic_approval to False.
findings.recommendation: Retain this safeguard and test it across workflows and error paths. This source check alone does not prove every execution path is safe.

findings.title: Human-confirmation regression test is present
findings.evidence: The test source contains a test named test_human_confirmation_always_required.
findings.recommendation: Extend coverage to malformed, contradictory, and incomplete inputs across all workflow families.

findings.title: Business impact needs measured evidence
findings.evidence: The report discusses handling time, time savings, or business impact alongside a statement that the evidence is not measured.
findings.recommendation: Run a controlled manual-versus-assisted evaluation measuring handling time, reviewer corrections, and exception rates.

findings.title: Extracted dates lack calendar-aware validation
findings.evidence: The inspected implementation references date-related fields but contains no recognized calendar-aware parsing call.
findings.recommendation: Validate extracted dates with calendar-aware parsing and flag impossible dates for human review. This source check recognizes common patterns, not every possible implementation.
